This small maize plot is on my family land, and I plant it together with cassava and a little melon as I have always done. I will buy one bag of NPK if I can manage the cost — maize needs the fertilizer or the cobs come small — and I will spread ash and the sweepings from my compound on the plot before planting. I keep seed from last year's harvest because the agro-dealer is far and the improved seed is dear. My children help me when school is out, and I will pay one young man for two days to help clear and ridge the land.
